limitations: The finite source-defined 48x48 procedural QOI has straight alpha 0/128/255. Native evidence covers centered Fit/1:1 at 1280x800 and1024x768; tiny/no-fit views and exhaustion/fence edge cases are actual host-function scopes unless separately recorded.

Image controls reuse the same released/decoded immutable pixels. Eight presentation frames plus one clear per ready boot prove current glyphs/image/guard and former image rectangles intersecting the current owned body; this is not whole-desktop erasure or arbitrary-image safety.

TLS uses an immutable BOOT public lab root and fixed controlled endpoint. No public Internet/CA/arbitrary URL, host proxy, TLS-secret capture, physical hardware, SMP or hostile-content containment is qualified.

UTF8 clipboard regression preserves exact source bytes and same-image cold reopen; one scalar per cell/finite fallback font is not shaping, grapheme composition, normalization, IME, bidi or Unicode filenames.

Asset screenshot prefix lengths/hashes use the checker's universal-newline-normalized UTF8 character model, joined to whole raw serial hashes; these are not captured raw-byte prefix lengths. Clipboard prefixes separately use exact raw bytes.
The Browser scalar audit is ISO-extracted ELF operand/mnemonic inspection, not whole-image, runtime stack/register/cache erasure or hostile containment proof.

NVMe host evidence covers exactly four runtime waits with bounded elapsed ticks/yield and DMA quarantine; clock/yield callbacks must return. No whole-driver timing, crash/power-loss, full-system deterministic replay, sustained daily-driver or System Proven claim.
